title: D12 Instruments / Bridge agent fleet
description: 04-UI-UX s3 D12 (X6). No data until C7 metrics are live (flag c7_metrics_live); series come from worker-a/b. worker-a/b export identical series, so every query aggregates with max by (tenant_id, centre_id, agent_id).

options.content: No data until C7 metrics are live (flag `c7_metrics_live`); series come from worker-a/b. Runbook: `infra/runbooks/instruments.md`.

panels.title: Agents by state
panels.description: No data until C7 metrics are live (flag c7_metrics_live); series come from worker-a/b.

targets.expr: count by (state) (max by (tenant_id, centre_id, agent_id, state) (lims_instruments_agent_state{tenant_id=~"$tenant_id"}) == 1)

panels.title: Fleet: tenant / centre / agent
panels.description: State, last heartbeat age, queue depth, clock offset, silent instruments, version. No data until C7 metrics are live (flag c7_metrics_live); series come from worker-a/b.

panels.title: Agent versions in the fleet
panels.description: Agents per agent_version (latest published release = highest version shown). No data until C7 metrics are live (flag c7_metrics_live); series come from worker-a/b.

targets.expr: count by (agent_version) (max by (tenant_id, centre_id, agent_id, agent_version) (lims_instruments_agent_info))

panels.title: C7 counters: update failures / config rejections / device-auth failures (15m)
panels.description: C7 counters (imported rules InstrumentsAgentUpdateFailed, InstrumentsAgentConfigRejected, InstrumentsDeviceAuthFailureSpike). No data until C7 metrics are live (flag c7_metrics_live); series come from worker-a/b.
